description: This Request for Information (RFI) initiates market research under Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 10 and is not a Request for Proposal. The Marine Corps Systems Command (MCSC), Product Manager, Engineer Systems (PdM ES), is conducting market research to identify potential sources capable of providing Tactical Gap Crossing Systems (TGCS) in support of Fleet Marine Force (FMF) operations. The TGCS is envisioned as an expeditionary bridging capability that affords Marine forces an expedient and transportable means to overcome natural and man-made obstacles to ensure tactical momentum and freedom of maneuver across the range of military operations.  See attached for RFI details.
